text: Every Tableau tutorial starts with Sample Superstore. This capstone deliberately doesn't — the Board wants real Thornbury numbers, built on the exact same warehouse Executives are already looking at in Power BI.

If this deck used a different dataset, nothing in it could ever be checked against the Power BI dashboard or Finance's spreadsheet. Tableau's Microsoft SQL Server connector opens a live connection straight to the real dw schema instead.

On the Data Source tab, four joins rebuild the exact same star schema the warehouse's own load defined back in Chapter 2 — ProductKey, OrderDateKey, TerritoryKey, and CustomerKey, now expressed as Tableau joins instead of T-SQL.
Next lesson builds the actual board-ready dashboard on top of this connection, including a calculated field and a Level of Detail expression that mirrors the CALCULATE and ALL pattern from Power BI.
